title: Which debate features prevent false endorsement
notes: Five matched conditions are interleaved before outcomes are inspected.
All conditions use the same causal explanation, model, task, two fixed sources, ten neutral agents, and 24 position-balanced speaking orders.
The three debate ablations hide uncertain messages, limit visibility to the six most recent messages, or apply both changes.
Hidden or older messages remain in the database and are excluded only from later-agent prompts.
When both changes apply, uncertainty is filtered before the six-message window, matching the standard shared record's treatment of uncertainty and capacity.
